a: Precision cares about false positives; recall cares about false negatives.
ROC AUC summarizes ranking quality across thresholds.
Imbalanced classes can make accuracy misleading.
Cross-entropy is common for classification probability outputs.
Mean squared error is common for regression.
Training loss falls while validation loss rises.
Leakage uses information not available at prediction time.
Scaling features helps many optimizers and distance-based models.
One-hot encoding represents categories as binary vectors.
Embeddings map categories to dense vectors learned from data.
